name: Darling Ingredients
outlook:
What Darling Ingredients says to expect

  • Fiscal year 2026: net debt and leverageDriven by an ongoing focus on deleveraging and confidence in the cash-generating power of its global operations, the company anticipates ending fiscal year 2026 with net debt at or below $3.0 billion, with a leverage ratio below 1.5X.
  • Fiscal year 2026: combined adjusted EBITDAReflecting this financial strength, Darling Ingredients reaffirms fiscal year 2026 Combined Adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.2-$2.3 billion, positioning the business to carry strong momentum into 2027.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 28, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
